I used to speak very incorrectly before, but Riva, by talking to me, has taught me to speak such high-profile English. Spoken English only improves by speaking, not by reading books. summary: A young girl showcases her advanced vocabulary by replacing common words with sophisticated synonyms, matching celebrity clips. She credits her fluency to the PW Talk app's AI teacher, Riva, who corrects her mistakes gently. She encourages viewers to practice speaking on the app to improve their English.
